mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation spike above 240.5 in CPIAUCSL triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 240.5 within the next month, or 20d returns are not negative when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: expanding demand and accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 do not move in the same direction simultaneously, or 20d returns are not positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% in a late-cycle expansion regime signals strengthening labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% in late-cycle expansion, or 60d returns are not positive when the condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST above 1170 signals robust demand in the housing sector, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 1170 within the next week, or 5d returns are not positive when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in RSAFS and INDPRO indicate expanding demand and supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and INDPRO do not both rise simultaneously, or 20d returns are not positive when both proxies increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% over the next 3 months, or 20d returns are not positive when unemployment declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% within the next month, or 20d returns are not negative when triggered.
